name: memory-store-limits-and-hygiene-auditor
description: Audits an Agent Space's memory footprint against the service limits (50 stores per space, 200 memories per store, 100 KB per memory) and retrieval-quality best practices (specific descriptions, folder structure, one fact per memory, no duplication), and produces a prioritized cleanup plan. Report-and-recommend only: it never modifies memory and never recommends deleting a managed store.

trigger.description: Runs weekly on MON at 10:00 UTC
